description: This file manages browser configuration refresh logic, including detecting profile changes, applying new configurations, and hot-reloading profiles from disk.

methods.name: changedProfileInvariants
methods.description: Detects differences between current and next browser profiles based on specific invariants.

methods.name: applyResolvedConfig
methods.description: Applies a new resolved browser configuration to the current browser server state, updating profiles and invariants.

methods.name: refreshResolvedBrowserConfigFromDisk
methods.description: Reloads browser configuration from disk and applies it to the current state, supporting hot reload.

methods.name: resolveBrowserProfileWithHotReload
methods.description: Resolves a browser profile with support for hot reloading, retrying from disk if profile is missing.
